newsitem.title: UK: S&P may cut A1 plus CP rating of BTR,units.
newsitem.headline: S&P may cut A1 plus CP rating of BTR,units.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Friday it had placed its A1 plus commercial paper rating of BTR Plc and related entities on creditwatch with negative implications.

"The CreditWatch placement follows the September 12 release of interim results for 1996 which show a net loss of 36 million stg after very large exceptional provisions of 462 million stg related to a major reshaping of BTR's existing 32 product groups into seven business groups," S&P said in a statement.

S&P said that BTR's new chief executive, Ian Strachan, had initiated a fundamental review of BTR's business portfolio which would result in the disposal of non-core businesses which represented 25 percent of 9.8 billion stg 1995 group sales.

"While BTR already has global leadership positions in some areas of activity, the group intends to rationalise its 32 virtually autonomous product groups into seven business groups in an effort to improve its overall business position which should in due course translate into revenue and profits growth," it said.
S&P said it intended to resolve the CreditWatch listing within a matter of weeks.
It said the following actions were taken.
BTR Dunlop Finance Inc. (GTD: BTR PLC)
